instruction: Shake the medium-sized plastic bottle with capped top horizontally after grabbing it.

source.instruction: Shake the medium-sized plastic bottle with capped top horizontally after grabbing it.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the bottle, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm, rotate roll and yaw to align with bottle orientation, and move forward.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +14, -4) cm, now 16 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (5, 5, 78) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, 5, 78) opening 0.80; table z = 74
